🚀 Step-by-Step: Build a $9 Digital Product & Store Using Base44 Goal: Create a digital product, build an online store, and start promoting it on TikTok or Instagram. Step 1: Create Your Base44 Account 🌐 * Visit Base44⁠. * Click Get Started. * Create your account using your email. * Open the AI app builder. * Start a new project. Step 2: Choose a Digital Product 💡 Choose a specific problem people want solved. Here are three examples: * 💰 Budget Planner: Help beginners organize their money. * 📱 30-Day Content Planner: Help small business owners create social media content. * 🧠 Productivity Tracker: Help busy professionals manage their daily tasks. For this example, we’re creating a 30-Day Social Media Content Planner priced at $9. Step 3: Copy and Paste This Prompt Into Base44 🤖 Base44 AI Builder Prompt Copy Paste this directly into the Base44 chat box. Build a modern, mobile-friendly digital product storefront called Content Growth Studio. Create a 30-Day Social Media Content Planner for beginners, including 30 daily content ideas, hook templates, caption prompts, a posting checklist, and a progress tracker. Include a homepage, product description, preview section, $9 purchase button, FAQ, and contact page. Use a professional blue, white, and black design. Create a secure checkout integration using supported payment providers, and only deliver the product after successful payment. Make the planner downloadable as a PDF or accessible to verified purchasers. Do not use fake testimonials or unsupported income claims. Step 4: Customize Your Store 🛍️ * Wait for Base44 to generate your website. * Preview the homepage and product. * Change the business name, colors, and descriptions. * Make sure your actual digital product contains everything advertised. * Upload your completed PDF if you plan to sell a downloadable product. Step 5: Set Up Payments 💳 * Open your Base44 project’s settings or integrations. * Check which payment providers are supported. * Connect an available payment provider. * Set your product price to $9. * Configure delivery after successful payment. * Test checkout and product access before publishing. Payment integration and automatic delivery may require additional setup or a paid plan.
